Subject: Re: Fwd: Partial outage on 2027-04-08 — SLA credit request (HBL-20270408)

Marissa / Olga,

I reviewed the attached uptime CSV and the incident timeline. Short summary and calc steps below — full workbook attached (credit_calc_sheet.xlsx).

1) SLA baseline: 99.9% monthly uptime (SLA §4.2).
2) Incident window: 00:20–01:05 UTC on 2027-04-08 → 45 minutes of impacted service.
3) Monthly minutes in April: 30 days * 24 * 60 = 43,200 minutes.
4) Uptime observed for April (per customer metrics + our telemetry) = 99.46% → shortfall = 0.44% of month = 190 minutes.
5) Contractual remedy: per SLA table, shortfall between 0.3%–0.5% → credit = 25% of monthly committed fee.
6) Harborline committed April spend: $53,700 → 25% credit = $13,425.

Recommendation: approve a $13,425 invoice credit to be issued to Harborline's billing account. Include a short internal memo line: "SLA remediation credit HBL-20270408 — 25% applied per SLA §4.2 (uptime shortfall 0.44%)."

Next steps if approved:
- Marissa: send customer-facing confirmation with attached incident timeline and the credit amount + expected processing window.
- Olga: once approved, route to Billing (billing@redwood.com) with invoice reference and the internal memo above (Billing will coordinate issuing the ledger credit and sending Harborline a credit note).
- Karthik: I'll attach the calc workbook (credit_calc_sheet.xlsx) and the exported telemetry used.

I flagged INF-7845 for traceability.

Karthik

Subject: Re: Partial outage on 2027-04-08 — SLA credit request (HBL-20270408)

Hi Tanya — thanks for raising this and for the detailed attachments. After internal review we've confirmed Harborline is eligible under SLA §4.2 for an offset due to the uptime shortfall during the April window.

Summary of outcome:
- Incident ID: HBL-20270408
- Uptime shortfall (April): 0.44% (190 minutes)
- Contract remedy: 25% credit bracket per SLA §4.2
- Credit amount: $13,425 applied to Harborline's April committed invoice (committed spend $53,700)

What happens next:
1) We will route an internal memo to our Billing team and request a ledger credit and credit note be generated for Harborline (billing@harborline.ai).
2) Billing typically processes account credits within 7–10 business days of memo receipt — we'll confirm when the credit posts.
3) Attached: incident_timeline.pdf and uptime_report_20270408.csv for your records.

If Harborline prefers a one-time invoice credit or an account balance adjustment, let us know and we will instruct Billing accordingly.

Apologies again for the disruption and thank you for the patience while we completed the review — we have a follow-up internal action to improve routing safeguards so we avoid similar regressions.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
